name: Daxer 6-Drawer Plastic Cupboard (DDC03E6D)
description: 6-drawer plastic storage cupboard with open-frame design and colourful handles. Lightweight, durable and ideal for organising clothes, toys or household items.
details: The Daxer DDC03E6D is a practical 6-drawer plastic cupboard with an open-frame structure. It features smooth-sliding drawers with colourful handles for easy identification. Each drawer can hold up to 5 kg. Lightweight yet sturdy, easy to clean and perfect for bedrooms, kids’ rooms or utility spaces in Sri Lankan homes.
